summary.text: Mark Schoenrock is a nonpartisan candidate for Nebraska State Senate District 32 in the November 3, 2026 general election, for an open seat, facing Shay Smith.
A U.S. Army veteran whose career experience includes working as a commissioner, Schoenrock led the May 12, 2026 primary with 60.9 percent of the vote.

paragraphs.text: Mark Schoenrock said in a Ballotpedia survey that he was born and raised in an agribusiness family in Jefferson County and was the first in his family to graduate from college.
Ballotpedia lists a high school diploma from Fairbury High School, a bachelor's degree from the University of Nebraska in 1978 and a graduate degree from Webster University in 1989.
He served in the U.S. Army from 1974 to 2015, including as an Army liaison officer to Congress.
Schoenrock said he was named Nebraska County Official of the Year in 2023, served as Nebraska Association of County Officials Southeast Director and mentored with Fairbury TeamMates for ten years.
He described himself as a conservative Republican veteran and listed tax reform, government spending, affordable housing, health care access and mental health among the top issues facing the state.
